## Pull request checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and clear English description.
- [ ] I ran the relevant backend tests and frontend build.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I checked that no secrets, credentials, or `.env` files are included.
- [ ] I considered authorization, input validation, and failure handling.
- [ ] I updated relevant architecture or user documentation.

## Verification

Describe the commands run and their results.
